description.en: Where agent systems differ from ordinary software — and where the old engineering still applies.
description.zh: Agent 系统和传统软件到底哪里不一样，哪些又还是老工程问题。

title.en: Agents: The Model Is an Indispensable Part — the Rest Is Engineering
title.zh: Agent：模型是个不可或缺的零件，剩下的都是工程

zh: 先说清楚我们在聊什么：模型、Harness、环境三个定义
三条边界：推理、副作用、人本
不讲什么：训练、权重、提示词偏方
和传统软件工程差在哪：90/10 论点
四立柱总图：灰、橙、红、浅绿
污染带：老模块的新契约
根因一句话：控制权交给概率函数之后
系列读法与篇目地图
en: What we are talking about: model, harness, environment
Three boundaries: inference, side effects, human
Out of scope: training, weights, prompt tricks
Where it differs from ordinary software: the 90/10 thesis
The four-pillar map: grey, orange, red, cyan
The contamination belt: old modules, new contracts
Root cause: control handed to a probabilistic function
How to read the series

zh: 场景：一个真实任务，从回车开始
turn 不是一次 HTTP 请求：消息进去，事件流出来
时间线全景：装配 → 推理 → 工具 → 执行 → 回灌 → 再推理 → 收尾
谁在驱动：为什么是循环而不是请求/响应
人可以中途打断：取消、插话、改主意
turn 的遗物：历史、状态、证据落在哪
小结：这张时间线就是后面九篇的目录
en: The scene: a real task, starting at enter
A turn is not one HTTP request: a message in, an event stream out
Timeline: assemble, infer, tool, execute, feed back, infer again, finish
Who drives: why a loop instead of request/response
The human can interrupt: cancel, interject, change their mind
What a turn leaves behind: history, state, evidence
Recap: this timeline is the table of contents for chapters 2–10

title.en: The core loop: plan, reflect, a state machine that may not stop
title.zh: 内核循环：规划、反思和一个可能停不下来的状态机

zh: 为什么核心是个循环，不是一次函数调用
循环的状态：输入、推理、动作、观察、再推理
规划与反思发生在哪：ReAct 不是框架，是循环里的相位
停止条件：模型宣告完成、人打断、预算耗尽、失败退出
不收敛的几种跑飞形态
事件溯源：codex 为什么把每一步写成 rollout 事件
checkpoint、恢复与续跑
对照：opencode 的循环长什么样
en: Why the core is a loop, not a function call
Loop states: input, inference, action, observation, re-inference
Where planning and reflection happen: ReAct as loop phases, not a framework
Stop conditions: model done, human interrupt, budget exhausted, failure
Forms of non-convergence when the loop runs away
Event sourcing: why codex writes every step as a rollout event
Checkpoint, resume, continuation
Contrast: what opencode's loop looks like

title.en: The model boundary: protocols, rate limits, failover, cost
title.zh: 模型边界：协议、限流、故障切换与成本

zh: 网关存在的理由：一个内核，多个 provider
两种协议：chat completions 与 responses
流式为什么是必须的：SSE 与增量渲染
reasoning 摘要等概率特性的协议适配
限流、重试、退避与幂等
故障切换：多 provider 与多模型
token 计费、成本追踪与预算上限
本地模型：ollama / lmstudio，边界不变
en: Why a gateway exists: one kernel, many providers
Two protocols: chat completions and responses
Why streaming is mandatory: SSE and incremental rendering
Adapting probabilistic features like reasoning summaries
Rate limits, retries, backoff, idempotency
Failover across providers and models
Token accounting, cost tracking, budget caps
Local models: ollama / lmstudio behind the same boundary

title.en: Context and memory: registers, RAM, and disk
title.zh: 上下文与记忆：寄存器、内存和磁盘

zh: 存储层级类比：寄存器（当前 turn）、内存（窗口）、磁盘（长期记忆）
寄存器：这一步真正送进模型的东西
内存里装什么：系统指令、历史、工具结果、附件
窗口不是数据库：预算、截断、装入优先级
压缩与换页：summarization 与 compaction
检索在层级中的位置：RAG 是换页机制，不是记忆本身
磁盘：跨会话长期记忆与 codex memories 的雏形
遗忘也是设计：该丢什么、什么时候丢
对照：两个样本各自的存储层级实现
en: The storage hierarchy: registers (turn), RAM (window), disk (long-term)
Registers: what actually goes into the model this step
What lives in RAM: instructions, history, tool results, attachments
The window is not a database: budget, truncation, load priority
Compression and paging: summarization and compaction
Where retrieval fits: RAG as paging, not as memory itself
Disk: cross-session memory and codex's memories prototype
Forgetting is design too: what to drop and when
Contrast: the two specimens' storage hierarchies

title.en: Tools and execution: how the model actually acts
title.zh: 工具与执行：模型怎么真正动手

zh: 模型怎么动手：function calling 协议
工具 schema 是写给概率读者的接口文档
apply_patch 为什么长那样：一个专用工具的设计取舍
shell 执行：从命令字符串到真实进程
输出回灌：截断、分页、结构化
失败也是信息：错误结果如何进上下文
工具的注册、发现与权限声明
对照：两个样本的工具体系
en: How the model acts: the function-calling protocol
Tool schemas as API documentation written for a probabilistic reader
Why apply_patch looks the way it does: one specialized tool's trade-offs
Shell execution: from a command string to a real process
Feeding results back: truncation, pagination, structure
Failure is information too: how errors enter the context
Tool registration, discovery, and declared permissions
Contrast: the two specimens' tool systems

title.en: Sandbox and the trust boundary: defending against the insider
title.zh: 沙箱与信任边界：防的是自己人

zh: 威胁模型变了：攻击者持有合法授权，而且真心觉得自己对
审批三档：全自动、逐次确认、只读
execpolicy：声明式的命令许可策略
OS 沙箱家族：seatbelt、landlock、bwrap、Windows sandbox
网络出口管控：默认不通，显式放行
文件系统隔离：worktree 与写入范围
人始终在环上：授权可以委托，权力不转移
对照：两个样本的默认安全姿态
en: The threat model changed: the insider holds valid authorization and is sincere
Three approval modes: full auto, per-action, read-only
execpolicy: declarative command policy
The OS sandbox family: seatbelt, landlock, bwrap, Windows sandbox
Egress control: deny by default, explicit allow
Filesystem isolation: worktrees and write scope
The human stays on the loop: permission delegated, authority not
Contrast: the two specimens' default security postures

title.en: Instruction layers: programming in natural language
title.zh: 指令层级：用自然语言编程

zh: 一种新文体：写给概率读者的可执行文本
层级全景：系统提示词 → AGENTS.md → 技能 → 斜杠命令 → 记忆
发现规则：AGENTS.md 在哪里被找到、如何合并
指令冲突时谁说了算：优先级与覆盖
提示注入：自然语言配置带来的新攻击面
版本化：codex 为什么把提示词文件放进仓库
指令工程的失效方式：歧义、过长、互相矛盾
对照：opencode 的指令层级
en: A new genre: executable text written for a probabilistic reader
The layer stack: system prompt, AGENTS.md, skills, slash commands, memory
Discovery: where AGENTS.md is found and how it merges
Who wins on conflict: precedence and overrides
Prompt injection: the new attack surface of natural-language config
Versioning: why codex keeps prompt files in the repository
How instruction engineering fails: ambiguity, length, contradiction
Contrast: opencode's instruction layers

zh: 三种扩展模式的分野：工具接入、生命周期挂点、内核扩展
MCP：进程外的工具与资源服务器
MCP 的信任传递：第三方能力凭什么能碰我的仓库
hooks：在生命周期事件上挂钩
plugin：更深的内核扩展面
扩展的权限模型与最小授权
供应链风险：装一个扩展等于开一道门
什么时候不该做扩展
en: Three extension modes: tool access, lifecycle hooks, kernel extension
MCP: out-of-process tool and resource servers
Trust transfer in MCP: why a third party may touch your repository
Hooks: attaching to lifecycle events
Plugins: the deeper kernel extension surface
Permission models and least privilege for extensions
Supply-chain risk: installing an extension is opening a door
When not to build an extension

title.en: One kernel, many faces; and multi-agent
title.zh: 一副内核，多副面孔；多智能体

zh: 为什么内核与界面必须分离
app-server 协议：同一副内核租给 CLI、TUI、IDE、云端
云端 task：headless 的执行形态
多智能体拓扑：主从、线程、消息板
agent 之间传什么：上下文、任务、还是结果
多 agent 什么时候是真需求，什么时候只是噱头
对照：codex 的 thread-store 与 message-board
en: Why kernel and interface must be separated
The app-server protocol: one kernel rented to CLI, TUI, IDE, cloud
Cloud tasks: the headless execution form
Multi-agent topologies: master-worker, threads, message boards
What passes between agents: context, tasks, or results
When multi-agent is a real need versus a gimmick
Contrast: codex's thread-store and message-board

title.en: Testing a probabilistic system; closing principles
title.zh: 概率系统怎么测；造 Harness 的几条原则

zh: 什么能单测，什么不能：确定性部件与概率部件的测试分界
trace 与回放：把一次运行变成可复现的证据
评测的根本困难：固定输入也没有固定输出
真人 journey 为什么不可替代
从九个样本里抽出的设计原则清单
边界显式化、默认不可信、上下文当内存、状态可回放
收口：回到 90/10，哪些手艺可以直接用，哪些必须重学
en: What is unit-testable and what is not: the testing divide
Trace and replay: turning one run into reproducible evidence
The hard problem of evaluation: fixed input, no fixed output
Why real human journeys cannot be replaced
Design principles distilled from the nine specimens
Explicit boundaries, distrust by default, context as memory, replayable state
Closing: back to 90/10 — which craft transfers and which must be relearned
